operations.purpose: Unchanged production estimator, continuous and dropout replay

operations.method: Python/NumPy read all 400 JSONL records; verify consecutive CARLA IDs, IMU/GNSS same-frame IDs, sample spacing, each noise norm against its configured bound, and true trajectory speed/range/yaw/single-track residual against the declared domain.

Verify no vehicles or sensors remain in a separate port-2011 query; check /proc/2478952/cmdline contains CarlaUnreal and -world-port=2011, then send SIGTERM only to that PID; verify it is absent, port 2011 closed, and original shared PID 2454708 still listens on 2000.
